column3: Manami Route ・ Anxiety Saturation
Yesterday, I tried e-mailing and calling her...
But in the end, I got no answer from Manami.
Seeing this, there's something I understood for the first time.
Manami was more a part of my life than I thought. It's like she was part of the air around me.
That soft air that gave me those peaceful days.
But now, with Manami avoiding me, it's like a gaping hole got carved in my chest.
The truth is, it hasn't even been a week since I've been unable to hear her voice.
But, since something I took for granted ended up disappearing, this sense of loss kept following me.
But, what am I supposed to say now?
So that last discussion wasn't enough... I have to think of something, anything...
What... what should I do? What would be the best thing to do to help Manami?
Let's see...
I am just a fairly ordinary high school student. I'm not expected to be able to do much. This means the only course I can take now is...
So, what do you want?
Sure must be a big deal, you bowing your head and begging disgracefully like that?
Yeah...
I need life counseling.
You do? From me?
...You can't help?
That should be obvious. I'm busy.
Come on, it's important! It's about Manami!
About that plain girl?
Ugh... She's just overtly grimaced.
But, is it my imagination? It feels like she isn't as disgusted as before.
Manami and I are... dating...
I already know that. What is it? Love squabble?
Let me finish! We were dating all right, but the other day, something happened-
I explained to Kirino what happened with Manami in the park.
Hmmmmm.
So we promised to give it our best... But right after that, she started avoiding me.
Did you seriously say that?
Huh?
Future Manami and stuff.
Yeah...
Are you stupid or what? Wasn't that a nice euphemism...
Euphemism...?
Yeah, you might have been serious when you said it. But to that plain girl, it's the same as if you said "We're not dating anymore".
No, that time, she even thanked me- *gasp*!
Back then, Manami also said, "Thanks for being honest"...! Don't tell me she's...!
But, if that's the case, how do I...
How about prostrating down and apologizing?
R-Really? Then right now I'll go and...!
*sigh*... Don't just swallow everything I say.
That girl wouldn't be happy at all from seeing your face on the ground. You'd know if you just thought about it.
I-I see... yeah, that's true...
You don't understand young girls' hearts because you have the sensitivity of an amoeba.
Ughh...
You're mistaken if you think all you have to do is apologize.
Then, what else can I do?
*sigh*... Hey.
I want to eat something sweet.
Huh? Why are you saying this so suddenly?
Sweets. Eat. Stop whining and follow.
Err...
Kyou-chan...?
Hey! Wait, Manami, don't just hide in the back! We heard you weren't feeling good, so we came to visit you!
I just came for the sweets.
As siblings.
I-Is that so? Well, I'm very grateful...
So, um, the candies are on the shop side. There's a fresh batch of manjuus.
Before that...
